entityRef.name: Platynum-47 (infotradescout/platynum-47) — stale ROADMAP vs. real unmerged T1 work

summary: Selective-Intelligence/ROADMAP.md states (2026-07-22) 'T0 shipped ... T1-T4 pending.' Verified 2026-07-25: branches feat/t1-github-connector (141ef21, GitHub connector) and feat/t1-oauth-broker (6d1dd00, one-click OAuth broker) contain real T1 implementation, dated 2026-07-22, and are NOT merged into the repo's default branch feat/mvp-editor (verified via git branch --contains). This repo also has no main branch.
whyThisMatters: The roadmap gives zero visibility that GitHub-connector and OAuth-broker T1 work already exists. Anyone reading only the roadmap would conclude T1 has not started; it has, just unmerged. This is a claimed-vs-actual gap, not a fabrication, but it is exactly the class of drift this governance lane exists to catch.
requestedAction: Decide whether to merge feat/t1-github-connector and feat/t1-oauth-broker into feat/mvp-editor now or explicitly hold them, then update the ROADMAP.md status line to reflect the real state either way.

evidence.notes: Run directly on 2026-07-25 against the local clone of infotradescout/platynum-47.

blockedBy: No recorded decision yet on merging the T1 branches or correcting the roadmap.
